About these numbers

The result and goals come from the score model (the style model for same-league games, Elo and recent xG for European ties). Checked against Betfair on 85 games the exchange was better on goals, and against closing odds on 2,579 league games it was worse on the result too: read it as a picture of the game, not a price to bet against the market. The game state's weights come from a walk-forward backtest (GS_BACKTEST.md). Only Paddy Power markets are listed in Lines it backs. Matchups: each outfield starter is paired one to one with the opponent nearest where he usually plays (average positions over his last 10 games), and the opponent's habit moves his expected count by what 35,000 starter-games showed it is worth (research/TRAIL-2026-11-02.md). 'Faces a fouler, so he will be fouled' did not predict and is never claimed. Chances there are the player model's before and after the matchup, without Super Sub or Sub On Play On; a price is marked when our chance times it is 1.05 or more. Market is the median of every book Oddschecker lists.
